info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_QR Payment Request Management API
info.description: The QR Payment Request Management API enables businesses to effectively manage and delete existing QR payment requests. This API provides the ability to remove specific payment requests identified by unique parameters, ensuring that outdated or unwanted requests do not clutter the system. Typically used by financial service providers and application developers, this API simplifies workflows related to payment request management. It supports various use cases, such as updating payment information and refining transaction records.

delete.summary: Delete a specific QR payment request.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a QR payment request identified by its unique ID. Upon successful deletion, the payment request will no longer be accessible or retrievable.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required for deleting a specific QR payment request identified by the unique payment ID 'PAY-300045'. Ensure all necessary authentication and authorization are managed before performing this operation.

204.description: Successful deletion; no content is returned.

DeleteQrPaymentRequest_PAY-300045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting payment requests. It is expected to contain a string value.
